parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit; a retry reuses it, a new user action mints a new one) that makes a retried request safe (ADR 0023, REST guideline section 2). Clients must ALWAYS send a non-empty value of 1-128 printable ASCII characters: with Postgres wired (every deployed runtime) a missing key is answered with 400 `idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one with 400 `idempotency-key-invalid`; a replay with the same key and the same method, path and body returns the original response plus `Idempotency-Replayed: true`, while the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`.

What is replayed (ADR 0054): a 2xx, and a refusal that is a function of the request alone (400 `malformed-request-body`, `order-without-lines`, `empty-sku`, `empty-order-id`, `invalid-fulfillment-site-id`; 404 `order-not-found`; 422 `non-positive-quantity`, `held-order-must-be-ship-complete`). What is NOT stored, so the key is released and the same request under the same key executes again (a different body under a released key is a new request, not a reuse): a 5xx (`downstream-unavailable`, `downstream-not-configured`, `internal-error`), and every refusal that depends on state that can change: 409 `concurrent-modification`, `order-not-held`, `no-backordered-lines`, `no-allocated-lines`, `promise-date-not-set`, `order-line-*`, `order-already-released`, and 400 `unknown-process-path`, `line-ineligible-for-resolved-path` (the process-path catalogue and product classification are fed by events from other contexts). Retry those with the same key. It is declared optional here only because the in-memory development mode (no `DATABASE_URL`, the mode the Schemathesis contract job boots) has no transactional store and gates the middleware off.
